```{r}
library(tidyverse)

cols_needed <- c("State Name", 
                 "County Name", 
                 "Year", 
                 "Parameter Name", 
                 "Arithmetic Mean", "State Code", "County Code")

pm18 <- read_csv("annual_conc_by_monitor_2018.csv", col_select = all_of(cols_needed)) %>% mutate(year = 2018)
pm19 <- read_csv("annual_conc_by_monitor_2019.csv", col_select = all_of(cols_needed)) %>% mutate(year = 2019)
pm20 <- read_csv("annual_conc_by_monitor_2020.csv", col_select = all_of(cols_needed)) %>% mutate(year = 2020)
pm21 <- read_csv("annual_conc_by_monitor_2021.csv", col_select = all_of(cols_needed)) %>% mutate(year = 2021)
pm22 <- read_csv("annual_conc_by_monitor_2022.csv", col_select = all_of(cols_needed)) %>% mutate(year = 2022)
pm_all <- bind_rows(pm18, pm19, pm20, pm21, pm22)
```
```{r}
colnames(pm18)
```
```{r}
pm_ca <- pm_all %>%
  filter(`Parameter Name` == "PM2.5 - Local Conditions",
         `State Name` == "California") %>%  select(`State Code`, `County Code`,
         `County Name`, Year, `Arithmetic Mean`)
  
```

```{r}
library(stringr)

pm_ca <- pm_ca %>%
  mutate(
    FIPS = str_c(
      str_pad(`State Code`, 2, pad = "0"),
      str_pad(`County Code`, 3, pad = "0")
    )
  )
```

```{r}
pm_ca <- pm_ca %>%
  group_by(FIPS, `County Name`, Year) %>%
  summarise(mean_pm25_year = mean(`Arithmetic Mean`, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")
```


```{r}
pm_ca_5yr_avg <- pm_ca %>%
  group_by(FIPS,`County Name`) %>%
  summarise(mean_pm25_2018_2022 = mean(mean_pm25_year, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")
Air_Pollution_by_County <- pm_ca_5yr_avg

```

```{r}
pm_ca_2022 <- pm_ca %>% filter(Year == 2022)
```



```{r}
Breast_Cancer_by_County <- read_csv("../../data/incd.csv")

```

```{r}

Breast_Cancer_by_County %>% 
  count(FIPS) %>% 
  filter(n > 1)

Air_Pollution_by_County %>% 
  count(FIPS) %>% 
  filter(n > 1)
```
```{r}
breast_data_unique <- Breast_Cancer_by_County %>% 
  group_by(FIPS) %>% 
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

pollution_data_unique <- Air_Pollution_by_County %>% 
  group_by(FIPS) %>% 
  slice(1) %>% 
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
combined_data <- left_join(breast_data_unique, pm_ca_5yr_avg, join_by(FIPS))
```

```{r}
combined_data %>% 
  count(FIPS) %>% 
  filter(n > 1) 
```

```{r}
combined_data <- drop_na(combined_data)
```

```{r}
combined_data <- combined_data %>% 
  slice(-c(1,2))
```

```{r}
combined_data <- combined_data %>% 
  slice(-2)
```

```{r}
combined_data <- combined_data %>% 
  slice(-45)
```


```{r}
str(combined_data$`mean_pm25_2018_2022`)
head(combined_data$`mean_pm25_2018_2022`)
```

```{r}
combined_data <- combined_data %>%
  mutate(
    `Age-Adjusted Incidence Rate - cases per 100,000` = as.numeric(str_trim(`Age-Adjusted Incidence Rate([rate note]) - cases per 100,000`)) )
```


```{r}
actual_data <- combined_data %>%
  select(
    FIPS,
    `County Name`,
    `Age-Adjusted Incidence Rate - cases per 100,000`, `Lower 95% Confidence Interval...5`, `Upper 95% Confidence Interval...6`,
    mean_pm25_2018_2022, `2023 Rural-Urban Continuum Codes([rural urban note])`, 
  )
```


```{r}
ggplot(actual_data, aes(
  x = mean_pm25_2018_2022,
  y = `Age-Adjusted Incidence Rate - cases per 100,000`
)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "red") +
  labs(
    x = "Average Air Pollution Level (PM2.5)",
    y = "Breast Cancer Incidence (per 100,000)",
    title = "Breast Cancer Rates vs Air Pollution by County (2018 - 2022)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
install.packages("ggrepel")
library(ggrepel)
```
```{r}
actual_data %>%
  filter(mean_pm25_2018_2022 > quantile(mean_pm25_2018_2022, 0.9) |
        `Age-Adjusted Incidence Rate - cases per 100,000` > quantile(`Age-Adjusted Incidence Rate - cases per 100,000`, 0.9)) -> labeled_counties

```

```{r}
ggplot(actual_data, aes(
  x = mean_pm25_2018_2022,
  y = `Age-Adjusted Incidence Rate - cases per 100,000`
)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "red") +
  labs(
    x = "Average Air Pollution Level (PM2.5)",
    y = "Breast Cancer Incidence (per 100,000)",
    title = "Breast Cancer Rates vs Air Pollution by County (2018 - 2022)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() + geom_text_repel(data = labeled_counties,
                aes(label = `County Name`),
                size = 3, color = "blue")
```


```{r}
install.packages(c("sf", "ggplot2", "dplyr", "tigris"))
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tigris)
```

```{r}
ca_counties <- counties(state = "CA", cb = TRUE, class = "sf")  # sf format
```
```{r}
ca_map_data <- ca_counties %>%
  left_join(actual_data, by = c("GEOID" = "FIPS"))
```

```{r}
ggplot(ca_map_data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = `Age-Adjusted Incidence Rate - cases per 100,000`), color = "black", size = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma") +
  labs(title = "Breast Cancer Incidence Across California Counties",
       fill = "Incidence Rate\n(cases per 100,000)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
ggplot(ca_map_data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = mean_pm25_2018_2022), color = "black", size = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma") +
  labs(title = "Average PM2.5 Across California Counties",
       fill = "PM2.5 (µg/m³)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(actual_data, aes(x = mean_pm25_2018_2022, 
               y = `Age-Adjusted Incidence Rate - cases per 100,000`,
               color = `2023 Rural-Urban Continuum Codes([rural urban note])`)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +
  labs(x = "PM2.5 (µg/m³)", y = "Breast Cancer Incidence Rate", color = "Rural-Urban Code", title = "Breast Cancer Rates vs Air Pollution by County (2018 - 2022)")
```
```{r}
actual_data$`Lower 95% Confidence Interval...5` <- as.numeric(combined_data$`Lower 95% Confidence Interval...5`)
actual_data$`Upper 95% Confidence Interval...6` <- as.numeric(combined_data$`Upper 95% Confidence Interval...6`)
```


```{r}
ggplot(actual_data, aes(x = mean_pm25_2018_2022,
               y = `Age-Adjusted Incidence Rate - cases per 100,000`)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = `Lower 95% Confidence Interval...5`,
                    ymax = `Upper 95% Confidence Interval...6`), width = 0.2) + labs(
    x = "Air Pollution Level (PM2.5)",
    y = "Breast Cancer Incidence (per 100,000)",
    title = "Breast Cancer Rates vs Air Pollution by County with Error Bars"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
ggplot(actual_data, aes(x = `2023 Rural-Urban Continuum Codes([rural urban note])`,
               y = `Age-Adjusted Incidence Rate - cases per 100,000`)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Rural-Urban Code", y = "Breast Cancer Incidence Rate")
```
```{r}

pm_summary <- actual_data %>%
  group_by(`2023 Rural-Urban Continuum Codes([rural urban note])`) %>%
  summarise(
    MeanRate = mean(mean_pm25_2018_2022, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(mean_pm25_2018_2022, na.rm = TRUE),
    N = n()
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(pm_summary, aes(x = `2023 Rural-Urban Continuum Codes([rural urban note])`, y = MeanRate, fill = `2023 Rural-Urban Continuum Codes([rural urban note])`)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = MeanRate - SD, ymax = MeanRate + SD), width = 0.2) +
  labs(
    x = "County Type",
    y = "Average PM2.5",
    title = "Comparison of 5 Year Average PM2.5: Urban vs Rural") +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Rural vs. Urban", values = c("Urban" = "#1f77b4", "Rural" = "#ff7f0e")) +
  theme_minimal() + geom_text(aes(label = N, y = MeanRate + SD + 5), size = 3)
```
